biblical_reference.note: God placed man in the Garden of Eden and commanded him not to eat from the tree of knowledge of good and evil. When man disobeyed and ate from the tree, God made garments of skin for him and sent him out of the Garden, placing a cherubim and a flaming sword to guard the way to the tree. Man was now in the shadow of sin, separated from the presence of God.
